identitySignals: The agenda name 'VSP Vision Care' matches the VSP Vision Care brand of Vision Service Plan, which describes itself as a not-for-profit eye health company (vspvision.com About page).
VSP's business of eye care and vision benefits fits OUSD's 'Student health, support & family services' category and a Health Services no-cost services agreement.
The agenda lists San Francisco, CA, but VSP's published headquarters is Rancho Cordova, CA. VSP serves the whole nation, including the Bay Area, so this is a mismatch rather than a confirmation.
No registry record (ProPublica, California Secretary of State or SAM.gov) was confirmed, and no cited page ties VSP to OUSD.
research.notes: Confidence is medium. The name matches, but the agenda location (San Francisco) differs from VSP's headquarters (Rancho Cordova), and I found no page linking VSP to this specific OUSD agreement. A reviewer should confirm that the contracting entity is Vision Service Plan / VSP Vision Care. I did not verify the EIN, California entity number or SAM UEI against a primary registry. The only EIN I found (94-1632821) came from a third-party aggregator, so I left it null. The phone shown is the corporate headquarters line from the VSP contact page. No general email address was listed, so email is null.

profile.summary: VSP Vision Care is part of Vision Service Plan, which describes itself as a not-for-profit eye health company. It provides vision insurance and access to eye care and eyewear through a network of eye doctors. It also offers eyewear and practice services to eye care providers.
